justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/examples/Wikipedia.java, HtmlToPlainText.java, ListLinks.java, and package-info.java. The package contains only 3 small, standalone example classes (249 total LOC including package-info), all centered on demo HTML fetching/formatting. package-info.java explicitly marks them as examples with no API contract, and pom.xml excludes org/jsoup/examples/** from the main jar while building a separate jsoup-examples classifier, indicating a small, isolated example bundle rather than a God Component.
